name: Dungeon Journal look round 2 and previews

nodes.name: Integrate and render previews
nodes.prompt: Round 2, stream P (after T and Q). Read context/dungeon-journal-contract.md 'Round 2'. (1) Fix seams between T ({{wT.summary}}) and Q ({{wQ.summary}}) if any (helpers wired, B.select used), in any of their files, no redesign. (2) Run the full suite (loop over tests/test_*.py with /tmp/qs-test-env/bin/python) and make it green; all QuestSharing/*.lua compile. (3) Extend tools/render_journal.py (you own it and context/renders/*): scenes home, quests (normal quest, a class-only quest, a done chain quest), bosses (with an EJ portrait), map, route; render with real client textures/fonts as it already does (/tmp/qs-test-env/bin/python tools/render_journal.py then python3 tools/render_journal.py paint). (4) Write context/renders/index.html: a gallery with each of our renders next to the matching Dungeon Journal reference screenshot copied from /tmp/dj_images into context/renders/reference/ (label: 'reference: Dungeon Journal by Exehn, not part of the addon'). Add a CHANGELOG Unreleased line for round 2. Report {files, summary, tests, notes}.
